annotatedSteps.studentWork: A reflex action is a sudden, automatic response to a stimulus without thinking (controlled by spinal cord).

annotatedSteps.description: Tracing the sequence of components in a reflex arc
annotatedSteps.studentWork: Path: stimulus → receptor → motor neuron → spinal cord → sensory neuron → effector (muscle)
annotatedSteps.teacherAnnotation: ½ Positions of sensory neuron and motor neuron are interchanged
annotatedSteps.correctedWorking: Stimulus → Receptor → Sensory neuron → Spinal cord → Motor neuron → Effector (muscle)

teacherNote: Marked against: Definition of reflex action as a sudden / automatic/involuntary response to a stimulus (1); Correct path of reflex arc: Stimulus → Receptor → Sensory neuron → Spinal cord/CNS → Motor neuron → Effector (2). Your definition of reflex action is accurate. However, in the reflex arc, sensory neurons transmit impulses from receptors to the spinal cord, and motor neurons carry the response from the spinal cord to the effector.
